source_manifest.transformations: Exact source selections; no tiling, artificial perturbations or regridding. Reference indexed by exact valid time and shared across members.
source_manifest.provider_processing: dynamical.org converts native GRIB to Celsius Zarr and rounds floating-point bits; not bitwise native GRIB.
source_manifest.license: CC BY 4.0 for provider archives; ECMWF Terms of Use also apply to ECMWF-derived data.
source_manifest.attribution: ECMWF IFS ENS forecast and NOAA NWS NCEP GFS data processed by dynamical.org from their open-data archives.
source_manifest.interpretation: Separate per-initialization/lead/member spatial metrics; descriptive pooled errors are not ensemble-mean forecast skill. Reference is GFS analysis, not independent truth. Overlapping valid times and related members are not independent samples.

timing: Direct wall time includes genuine variant read/decode/coordinate validation, FP32 scaling/packing, output metadata, host tensor, upload/copy to fixed GPU input (GPU engines), FNO, full host return, uncompressed NPZ write/close. Models remain resident. Open-once reuses one shared dataset handle; reopen opens each request. No prepared input/output cache. Primary has no profiler/events/stage synchronization. Readback/hash/FP64 validation/cleanup outside timers.
setup: Common imports/source-hash/model loading and shared reader opening are recorded separately. Graph setup includes clone, side-stream warmup, capture/instantiate and first replay; net allocator changes observed after eager warmup. All graphs/source handles coexist even during eager/CPU timings. Setup is excluded from primary; estimated amortization is not measured cold startup.
variants: Same two disjoint real windows as pinned reference run: A first B frames, B next B frames. Variant alternates by repeat for all matched engine/reader cases. Each request actually rereads and prepares its requested variant.
limits: OS/library caches uncontrolled and warmed by setup/reference/readback. File close is not fsync/durable media persistence. No async overlap, remote retrieval, precision change, training or forecast assessment. Stage profiles and traces are separate later observations and may differ from primary times. GPU allocator probes are not total VRAM or standalone eager memory.
